cmek001.name: Atlas Dominator
cmek001.description: A towering war machine, designed to withstand entire armies and unleash devastating long-range bombardments.
cmek001.appearance: A four-legged colossal frame with a cathedral-like torso block and deep armor skirts. Gunmetal and brass paneling is crossed by maintenance hatches and heavy cable trunks.

cmek002.name: Leviathan Warlord
cmek002.description: A battlefield colossus, armed with experimental energy weapons and a fortress-grade armor chassis.
cmek002.appearance: A four-legged colossal carrier with twin deck towers and wide side casemates. Matte black plating is segmented by red conduit channels and reactor vent stacks.

cmek003.name: Titanus Annihilator
cmek003.description: A slow-moving harbinger of destruction, wielding unstoppable firepower and impervious shielding.
cmek003.appearance: A two-legged colossus with four superheavy arms mounted to a broad reactor thorax. Pale steel armor panels sit over layered shield nodes and segmented service gantries.

cmek004.name: Oblivion Sentinel
cmek004.description: A legendary defensive platform, built to control entire battlefields with overwhelming resilience.
cmek004.appearance: A four-legged defensive citadel frame with a low center body and expanded side bastions. Dark slate plating is reinforced by angular buttress beams and emitter pylons.

cmek005.name: Doom Bringer
cmek005.description: A slow-moving titan of war, designed to break enemy lines with unrelenting force and unmatched endurance.
cmek005.appearance: A four-legged colossal siege frame with a segmented upper hull and heavy frontal ram plates. Burnt-iron armor is marked by white unit codes, blast shutters, and exhaust ducts.
